cases.name: COMP1001

import re
found = re.findall(r'\b(True|False)\b', __stdout__)
assert len(found) == 6, 'Print exactly six Boolean results, one per property, in the listed order (found ' + str(len(found)) + ').'
assert found == ['False', 'True', 'False', 'False', 'True', 'False'], 'For ' + 'COMP1001' + ' the six results in order should be False, True, False, False, True, False; you printed ' + ', '.join(found) + '.'
